name: token-usage
description: Shows AI token usage and cost per prompt in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Read whichever source was most recently active in this workspace.
Cursor spend, read from Cursor's billing API (requires being signed in to Cursor).
tokenUsage.provider.description: Which usage data source to read. "auto" picks the most recently active, since Claude Code often runs inside Cursor's terminal and the host editor does not indicate which agent is spending.

tokenUsage.claudeProjectsPath.description: Root directory containing Claude Code transcript folders.

tokenUsage.customLedgerGlob.description: Path to a custom JSONL usage ledger, used when provider is 'custom'.

tokenUsage.display.description: What to show in the status bar.

tokenUsage.pricing.description: Per-model rate overrides in USD per million tokens, e.g. { "claude-opus-5": { "input": 5, "output": 25 } }.

tokenUsage.warnThresholdUSD.description: Highlight the status bar item once session cost exceeds this many USD. 0 disables.

tokenUsage.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar item priority. Higher numbers sit further left.

tokenUsage.budget.cursorUSD.markdownDescription: Monthly budget in USD for Cursor, counting every project on the account. `0` disables budget tracking for Cursor.

tokenUsage.budget.claudeUSD.markdownDescription: Monthly budget in USD for Claude Code, counting every project on the account. `0` disables budget tracking for Claude Code.

tokenUsage.budget.cycleStartDay.description: Day of the month the billing cycle starts. Months without that day use their last day.

tokenUsage.budget.warnAtPercent.description: Warn once per cycle as spend passes each of these percentages of the budget.
